clarifications.title: Friday-night coconut curry
clarifications.description: Turn a flexible curry idea into a recipe: choose the servings, dietary constraints, protein, heat, and cooking method before setting the quantities.

questions.title: Who is eating?
questions.question: How many people should the curry feed, and do you want leftovers?
questions.rationale: Portions set the ingredient quantities and the pan size.

alternatives.label: Two, no leftovers
alternatives.description: A small batch for one dinner.

alternatives.label: Two, plus tomorrow's lunch
alternatives.description: Four portions with a second meal planned.

alternatives.label: Six at the table
alternatives.description: A larger batch that may need two pans.

questions.title: Diet and allergies
questions.question: Does the meal need to be vegan, and are there allergies or ingredients to avoid?
questions.rationale: Curry paste can contain shrimp, and sauces or toppings can introduce allergens.

alternatives.label: Vegan
alternatives.description: Use plant-based protein and check the curry paste.

alternatives.label: Vegetarian
alternatives.description: Dairy and eggs are acceptable; fish and shrimp are not.

alternatives.label: No dietary preference
alternatives.description: Choose the protein freely, but still confirm allergies.

questions.title: Main ingredient
questions.question: Which protein should anchor the curry once the dietary constraints are known?
questions.rationale: The protein changes the preparation, cooking sequence, and texture.

alternatives.label: Chickpeas
alternatives.description: Canned chickpeas make a low-preparation plant-based option.

alternatives.label: Firm tofu
alternatives.description: Pan-fry separately for a crisp surface.

alternatives.label: Chicken
alternatives.description: Requires handling raw poultry and checking that it is cooked safely.

questions.title: How spicy?
questions.question: Should the base curry be mild for everyone, or should it carry the heat?
questions.rationale: Heat is easier to add at the table than remove from a finished pot.

alternatives.label: Mild, chili on the side
alternatives.description: Each diner adjusts their own plate.

alternatives.label: Medium throughout
alternatives.description: One consistent heat level for the whole pot.

alternatives.label: Hot throughout
alternatives.description: Choose only if every diner wants a spicy meal.

questions.title: Time and equipment
questions.question: How much active cooking time is available, and which pan or appliance will you use?
questions.rationale: A quick stovetop meal needs a different sequence from a mostly hands-off cook.

alternatives.label: 30-minute stovetop
alternatives.description: Use one wide pan and ingredients that cook quickly.

alternatives.label: 60-minute relaxed cook
alternatives.description: Allow time to brown the protein and roast vegetables separately.

questions.title: Write the final recipe
questions.question: What exact ingredients, quantities, steps, and serving plan fit the choices above?
questions.rationale: The final recipe should reconcile the portions, restrictions, heat, and available cooking time.

clarifications.title: Shopping cart: from basket to paid order
clarifications.description: Define the first release for a small online shop. Resolve identity, pricing, stock, shipping, and payment rules, then turn them into testable acceptance criteria.

questions.title: Launch market
questions.question: Which countries and currencies must the first release support?
questions.rationale: The launch market affects taxes, payment methods, addresses, and shipping rules.

alternatives.label: Netherlands, EUR
alternatives.description: One launch country with a narrow operational scope.

alternatives.label: EU, EUR only
alternatives.description: More destination and tax cases without currency conversion.

alternatives.label: Multiple currencies
alternatives.description: Requires explicit exchange-rate and settlement rules.

questions.title: Physical products only?
questions.question: Can the first release assume every sellable item is a physical product with a stock count?
questions.rationale: Digital products, subscriptions, and preorders need different fulfillment and availability rules.

alternatives.label: Physical stock only
alternatives.description: Every order requires shipping and available inventory.

alternatives.label: Physical and digital
alternatives.description: Mixed carts need fulfillment rules per line.

alternatives.label: Include preorders
alternatives.description: Availability and promised delivery dates become separate concepts.

questions.title: Guest checkout
questions.question: Must customers create an account before they can pay?
questions.rationale: Identity rules affect conversion, saved carts, order lookup, and personal-data handling.

alternatives.label: Guest or account
alternatives.description: Support checkout without registration and optional saved details.

alternatives.label: Account required
alternatives.description: One identity model with a mandatory registration step.

alternatives.label: Guest only at launch
alternatives.description: Avoid account features while defining secure order lookup.

questions.title: Cart lifetime and merging
questions.question: How long should carts survive, and what happens when a guest with a cart signs in?
questions.rationale: Merging can create duplicate lines, exceed stock, or revive expired prices.

alternatives.label: Keep this device's cart
alternatives.description: Use the current cart after sign-in; explain what happens to the saved cart.

alternatives.label: Merge quantities
alternatives.description: Combine matching variants and revalidate stock and prices.

alternatives.label: Ask the customer
alternatives.description: Make the conflict visible before replacing either cart.

questions.title: Inventory reservation
questions.question: When, if ever, should adding an item reserve stock for the customer?
questions.rationale: Reservations trade fewer checkout surprises for stock held by shoppers who may never pay.

alternatives.label: Validate at checkout
alternatives.description: A cart does not reserve inventory; availability may change.

alternatives.label: Reserve during payment
alternatives.description: Hold inventory briefly and define expiry and release behavior.

alternatives.label: Reserve on add
alternatives.description: Define a visible hold timer and protect against stock hoarding.

questions.title: Price changes and discounts
questions.question: Which price is binding, and can customers combine promotional codes with sale prices?
questions.rationale: The displayed cart total and the amount charged need one explicit pricing contract.

alternatives.label: Reprice before payment
alternatives.description: Show changes and require the customer to confirm the updated total.

alternatives.label: Time-limited price quote
alternatives.description: Honor a quoted total until a stated expiry.

questions.title: Shipping calculation
questions.question: When can the customer see the full shipping charge, and what qualifies for free shipping?
questions.rationale: Shipping thresholds depend on destination, item eligibility, and whether discounts reduce the qualifying subtotal.

alternatives.label: Flat rate per destination
alternatives.description: Predictable rates with a clear free-shipping threshold.

alternatives.label: Carrier-calculated rate
alternatives.description: Needs address and parcel details plus a carrier-failure policy.

alternatives.label: Collection only
alternatives.description: Replace shipping with pickup locations and collection windows.

questions.title: Payment and order creation
questions.question: Which payment methods are in scope, and when does a checkout become an order?
questions.rationale: Payment redirects and asynchronous confirmations can arrive late, twice, or out of order.

alternatives.label: Pending order before redirect
alternatives.description: Track an unpaid order and confirm it from verified provider events.

alternatives.label: Order after confirmed payment
alternatives.description: Persist a checkout attempt that can be reconciled if the browser disappears.

questions.title: Failure and retry behavior
questions.question: What should happen after a declined payment, an expired stock hold, or a repeated Pay click?
questions.rationale: Retries must not create duplicate charges or orders, and recoverable carts should remain usable.

questions.title: Acceptance criteria
questions.question: Which concrete examples prove the cart is ready, including price changes, stock races, guest sign-in, and payment retries?
questions.rationale: Observable outcomes make the business rules testable across the browser, backend, and payment integration.

clarifications.title: A car-free weekend in the Ardennes
clarifications.description: Plan a two-night escape from Amsterdam using public transport. Start with a few independent, open-ended questions before committing to a destination or itinerary.

questions.title: What makes it worthwhile?
questions.question: What would make this weekend feel successful: long hikes, quiet reading, good food, time together, or something else?
questions.rationale: A shared purpose helps distinguish an appealing destination from an appealing trip.

questions.title: Dates, budget, and mobility
questions.question: Who is coming, which dates work, and what are the per-person budget and walking limits?
questions.rationale: Time, money, and accessibility can rule out a route before accommodation becomes relevant.

questions.title: Can the whole trip be car-free?
questions.question: Is public transport plus walking sufficient for the last leg, including the Sunday return, or would a booked taxi be acceptable?
questions.rationale: A railway station near a destination does not establish that the accommodation and trailheads are reachable on the intended dates.

alternatives.label: Train, bus, and walking only
alternatives.description: Choose accommodation around verified weekend connections.

alternatives.label: A booked taxi is acceptable
alternatives.description: Include cost and confirm availability before booking accommodation.

questions.title: Choose a base
questions.question: Which town and accommodation best fit the desired experience and a verified door-to-door route?
questions.rationale: Choose the base after checking the constraints rather than forcing the itinerary around an attractive listing.

questions.title: A weekend that survives rain
questions.question: What is the outdoor plan, what replaces it in heavy rain, and what needs booking ahead?
questions.rationale: A fallback keeps the weekend useful without assuming good weather or inventing opening hours.

proposals.message: Consider two further checkout requirements: accessible review of a changed total, and a defined retention policy for abandoned guest carts. Review these additions before accepting them into the plan.

questions.title: Accessible total changes
questions.question: How will keyboard and screen-reader users notice a changed total and confirm it before payment?
questions.rationale: A price-change rule is incomplete unless every customer can perceive and act on the updated amount.

questions.title: Guest-cart retention
questions.question: When should abandoned guest carts and any contact details collected during checkout expire?
questions.rationale: A useful cart lifetime does not by itself define how long personal data should be retained.
